stories.headline: Crypto has become part of Iran's arsenal
stories.body: Iran is charging tolls to cross the Strait of Hormuz, and demanding payment in crypto, which helps it both raise money and evade U.S. sanctions.

stories.headline: Why Community Bank Accounts Must Pass the ‘Everyday Test’
stories.body: There’s no shortage of issues testing community banks these days. Managing real-time payments, attracting Gen Z and integrating AI are just a few. But there’s one test community banks might have pushed down on the list. It’s the “everyday test” and it’s the central issue facing community banks today. Here’s how the everyday test […]
